name: Curing the Sick
summary: Darkshore’s deer are sick, and Curing the Sick asks you to bring them relief. Alanndarian Nightsong gives you salve to treat the poisoned animals before you report to the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.

sections.title: A Plague in the Woodlands
sections.body: In Darkshore, deer fall sick from the Cliffspring River south to the border of Ashenvale. They wander the misty woods, weakened by toxins in the soil and streams. After you gather the needed reagents, Alanndarian Nightsong gives you freshly brewed animal salve to treat the afflicted deer.

sections.title: Eyes Unveiled in Moonglade
sections.body: After you treat ten deer, you report to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade. Auberdine gains some relief, but Dendrite sees the herds’ sickness as a sign of deeper corruption spreading across northern Kalimdor. He warns that leaders in Darnassus debate while the rot advances, and the Cenarion Circle must stay alert to its reach across the continent.

faq.q: Why are the deer in Darkshore sick?
faq.answer: The deer are sick from corruption spreading through Darkshore’s soil and water, from the Cliffspring River south to Ashenvale. They graze on tainted plants and drink the affected water, growing weak and diseased.

faq.q: Who prepares the curative salve used on the deer?
faq.answer: Alanndarian Nightsong prepares the curative animal salve in Auberdine from reagents you gather. Her batch has ten doses for the suffering animals, while she and the townsfolk try to make more.

faq.q: Why does Dendrite Starblaze care about the deer?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze oversees druid training for the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade. Caring for the deer tests a druid’s duty and confirms that dangerous corruption is spreading through Kalimdor’s wilderness.

faq.q: What political tension does Dendrite Starblaze hint at?
faq.answer: Dendrite says some night elf authorities in Darnassus recognize the growing rot, while others ignore its warning signs. He urges you to face the hard truths about the natural world.

faq.q: Where can the sickly deer be found?
faq.answer: The sickly deer roam across Darkshore, from south of the Cliffspring River, just north of Auberdine, to the border of Ashenvale.

faq.q: What does a druid learn from completing this task?
faq.answer: You learn to cleanse poison through practical work: treating suffering forest animals with a physical cure joins botanical remedies with spiritual mastery over poison.

angles.text: As a druid, you prove your commitment to preserving balance and prepare to purge poisons with druidic magic.
As a night elf, you know Darkshore as the edge of your people’s settled lands. The sickness among its deer is an ominous sign for the kaldorei.
